meta.title: BrickTally - Every Brick Counts
meta.description: Verify your LEGO® sets are complete before selling or storing. Count every piece and track multiple sets with BrickTally.
meta.ogDescription: Check if your LEGO® sets have all pieces before selling or storing. Count every brick to confirm 100% completeness.
meta.keywords: LEGO®, set verification, brick counting, complete set checker, LEGO® inventory, sell LEGO®, used LEGO® sets

landing.heading: Verify Your LEGO Sets Are Complete
landing.description: BrickTally helps you count every piece in your LEGO® sets before selling, storing, or building. Enter a set number to get a full parts checklist powered by the Rebrickable database.
landing.featureTrack: Track parts, spare parts, and minifigures separately
landing.featureFilter: Filter by colour to focus on one group at a time
landing.featureExport: Export missing parts to BrickLink, Pick a Brick, Rebrickable, or as a plain text list
landing.featureBadge: Generate a completion badge for eBay or marketplace listings
landing.featureMobile: Optimised for tablets and phones — always at your fingertips when sorting pieces
landing.featurePwa: Works offline as a PWA — install it on your device
landing.featureBackup: Backup and restore your progress across devices

To use:

3. Select "BrickLink XML" format
4. Upload the downloaded file
